description: Albert Cuypstraat 138-150 (1891-92): 6 m market-street fronts of a shop and three upper storeys of red-brown brick; three axes of white T-windows under flat heads with a white keystone block; white painted band pieces across the piers at the sill, transom and head lines of every upper storey; iron wall anchors on the piers under each floor; a brick frieze with a corbel table under a white cornice at 14.0 m; one white pediment dormer with a hoist beam over the middle axis

match.note: Albert Cuypstraat 138-150 (1891-92), 5.8-6.4 m; cornice 14.0 m on the 2022-03-21 strip (3DBAG eaves 12.8-15.2 m read the gutter or the dormer zone)

pediment-dormer.note: 138-150: one white dormer 1.6 m wide over the middle axis, 14.1-16.3 m under a pediment; hoist beam over the dormer window

door-left.note: a residential door at the left party wall beside the shop

rhythm.identicalBays: every upper storey: 3 T-windows of one width
rhythm.groundFloor: a shop per house behind the market stalls
rhythm.roofline: brick frieze with a corbel table, white cornice at 14.0 m, one pediment dormer with a hoist beam
schemaLimits: the frieze's corbel table is plain brick
the market stalls in front of the shops are not part of the building
